notes:
Lead: CTO (Marta Ivanova) + Head of Product (Jonas Keller). Mid-market B2B SaaS that surfaces product analytics + guided insights to enterprise customers. Currently prototyping conversational product assistant and embeddings-backed search. Primary ask: start on Hosted API for fast integration, then migrate to Dedicated once POC shows latency and cost profiles. Data residency is a hard requirement for EU customers: all PII and inference payloads must stay in EU. They want primary region in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) with optional failover to eu-west-1 (Ireland) but no US egress without a legal justification. 

POC goals: validate P95 latency <= 250ms for 1-2k daily active chat users, throughput ~30-40 req/s during peak demo, embeddings gradient recall target > 0.78 on internal eval set, cost per 1k chat tokens under internal threshold. Will bring sample anonymized logs and a 10k-document corpus for search tests.

Quoted: "We need predictable tail latency in EU — can't have cold-starts routing to US for critical customers." — Marta. Product: "If latency goes up >200ms we see drop in engagement in our beta." — Jonas.

Security asks: SSO/SAML integration, workspace-level audit logs, encryption with customer KMS, retention controls (30-90 days configurable). Compliance path: vendor SOC2 docs requested; will need data processing addendum with EU-only clause.

Commercial / procurement notes: interested in 12-month committed Dedicated pilot after successful Hosted POC. Price sensitivity: internal cap on per-1M-token spend; asks for predictable unit pricing and transparent burst costs. Wants an optional clause for commit conversion credit if they go Dedicated.

Operational: asks for canary rollout capability across regions, model pinning (redwood-verified variants), and autoscaling profiles to avoid cold-start latency. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to meet cost targets.

Internal sentiment: high technical buy-in; procurement/legal slower. Recommended AE approach: provide EU-region performance benchmarks, Dedicated sizing worksheet, and a draft EU data residency addendum.
